description: Investigate City Hall, the flat cap worker's mysterious code words: "Time Problem" and "Did a Little Tampering"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The crowd in the tavern gradually dispersed, and the coachman had long returned to the carriage to wait for you.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Let's go back to sleep, I'm so tired."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let's go, it's time to rest a bit."

conversation.speaker: player13
conversation.text: For now, let's head back to the inn we booked to rest.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Do you want me to keep watch? I usually work at night; seems I'll have to adjust my sleep schedule later?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Preparing to return to the hotel.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Standing at the tavern entrance, saying to everyone that I'm feeling very energetic tonight.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Professor, you folks are finally out! "Old Louis whistled loudly, tightened his frayed scarf, then breathed white air into his palms.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Getting into the carriage.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Carrying the sack, clattering and clanging, boarding the carriage first.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Climbing into the carriage limply, throwing the wallet to Bailan, asking her to help pay later, and taking a short nap.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Louis's pipe paused mid-air, squinting to examine Johnson's dusty trouser cuffs. When did our elegant Miss Bailan start taking in vagrants? He winked at Johnson, his frost-reddened nose wrinkling into a smile.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Glancing over, looking displeased at Old Louis, retorting, "You're the vagrant! I just don't care for neat dressing; I'm here on vacation~~~"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Snoring sounds.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Two friends"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Louis's pipe nearly fell from his mouth; he quickly caught it with his reddened hands. The Parisian wind specializes in curing stubbornness! He laughed heartily, tossing a wool blanket to Johnson, "Cover up quick, with those thin clothes of yours, don't catch a chill."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Taking a small file from the leather jacket, rustling while filing nails, turning head away, obediently wrapped in the blanket.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Adjusting the blanket, snoring sounds.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Louis cracked a loud whip in the air, Lightning's horseshoes tapping a crisp rhythm on the stones. After a bumpy ride, we're at the Ritz! Old Louis lifted the carriage curtain, letting in the bright outside lights.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra constitution

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it shall be answered. <player4>'s constitution wish:

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Holding up both hands under the night sky, examining the manicured nails by the moonlight.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Though a bit bumpy, it's tolerable.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The tavern landlady's special mint drink earlier took effect; you feel an unprecedented comfort.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Not bad."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Louis grinned at Johnson's bulging bag, "If you lug that 'travel bag' into the lobby, you might be mistaken for a coal delivery boy!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Goodnight, everyone."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Pouting, "It's not that; it's my tools of the trade...", jumping off the carriage, wiping hands clean with a cloth strip, returning the blanket to Old Louis with both hands, "Thank you, old man."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Waking up groggily, eyes looking at player4 as if asking if the money was paid.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #player4, having been busy all day, decides to sleep.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "I'll just stay inside to borrow some warmth, I can spend the night leaning on the corridor windowsill."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: When player2 gets up, they find the wallet has been placed on their lap, while Old Louis is stuffing a few coins into his pocket.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Suddenly realizing they were staring at the wrong person, shakes their head and gets off the car.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Seven o'clock sharp! He flicks the reins and drives into the fog, rest easy and go back to sleep, my living alarm clock is more accurate than the bells of Notre Dame!

conversation.speaker: player13
conversation.text: Wakes up early, does a simple wash-up, then goes to the front desk to check out, afterwards heads to the tavern entrance to wait for the rendezvous.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Smells pretty good, I'll go get breakfast later, looking at it makes me hungry."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Actually, you all came out after having breakfast.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Today we're going to the City Hall, right?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Brings Old Henry some bread as usual.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Yes, we need to investigate."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #This time also packed two extra strips of bacon and a fried egg.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Yes, I also need to go get my passport fixed" #Reminds everyone.

conversation.speaker: player13
conversation.text: "Yo." Seeing everyone come out, twists neck and walks over. "About today's search content, do you have any ideas?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "This investigation is about the whereabouts of a statue, but this time we've changed our approach."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Holy Mary! He hurriedly wipes his hands on his apron before taking the greased paper package. Lightning suddenly turns its head and bites his sleeve. He laughs and scolds, slapping the horse's nose: Greedy devil! Then breaks off half a strip of bacon and stuffs it into the horse's mouth, turning to wink at player2. If you spoil him like this, tomorrow this old fellow will be demanding to have breakfast at the Ritz!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "It's their problem if they don't serve him" #Pats the horse's head.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That historically somewhat famous Count."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "We'll trouble you to take us to the City Hall today."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Louis smears bacon grease on the reins and cracks a loud whip: Off to the City Hall! Lightning's horseshoes tap out a brisk rhythm on the main road.

conversation.speaker: player13
conversation.text: "Good horse." Strokes the horse's neck. "For a while, I really wanted to transfer to the cavalry."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Yes, cavalry has always been a symbol of honor."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Takes out a cigarette from the leather jacket, pulls out a lighter, flicks it open with a click to light up, leans on the carriage side and blows smoke rings.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Feels a faint headache, hoping this uneasy feeling disappears soon.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Cough, runs pretty fast." #The carriage's jolting makes Johnson swallow some ash.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Cavalry? Old Louis taps the carriage floor with his boot heel. In 1918, I saw German Uhlans at the Marne. He lifts his trouser leg, revealing a crescent-shaped scar on his calf. That bastard warhorse bites harder than its master's saber!

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Takes out paper and pen from the coat pocket, casually opens the briefcase, takes out a manuscript sheet, uses the pen to sketch the past on it. Looking down, inadvertently notices a few added marks on the travel bag, reaches out a hand, gently strokes those medals representing the past.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: In front of the City Hall square, Old Louis sharply pulls the reins, stopping the carriage steadily beside the stone lion statue.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Feels shouldn't suffer alone, extends a finger to tease player4.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "After all, training a cavalryman requires a lot of time." #Nods silently, moves fingers away from the case, closes the briefcase again.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: In the morning light, the neo-Renaissance architectural complex stands majestically, with over twenty marble steps crowded with people carrying briefcases. A doorman in a double-breasted uniform is scolding a worker trying to paste a flyer on the base of the Henry IV statue.

conversation.speaker: player13
conversation.text: "But, love the job you do." Nimbly jumps off the carriage.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Holds onto the handle to prevent falling. "Wow, this cigarette isn't even finished yet, the old man's carriage is really fast." #Looks at the still-sparking cigarette, snuffs it out. Only three cigarettes left in the pack, so tosses it to Old Louis. "Thanks for the blanket yesterday, old man."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Let's go. Apart from the school's academic affairs office, I haven't really been to places like this much."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Gathers the burlap sack and gets off the carriage.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Thought of a reason yet, everyone?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "If it's a cultural relics investigation, then Professor Bailan can step in."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Louis catches the cigarette pack mid-air like a throwing star—whoosh! He lifts the wool blanket under the carriage seat, magically pulls out half a bottle of apple wine. The lightning-fast, life-risking runs all rely on this old buddy remembering the grass in the alley behind the city hall! He unscrews the cap and takes a big gulp, the liquor dripping down his gray beard onto his front.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Logically speaking, we should be here for a cultural relics investigation. That noble has been dead for so long. Grave robbers often claim they're here for archaeology too."

conversation.speaker: player13
conversation.text: "But I'm a bit worried the French won't give me a good look... Maybe I should wait outside?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Or there's another illegal method."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "And then wait for him to get shot to death?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It won't come to that."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I still think archaeological research is more reliable."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "No problem, no problem. I've been here long enough, my legs run fast and nimble. As long as the mansion's courtyard wall isn't too high, I can climb in myself."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Quietly walks ahead, goes to the front desk to inquire about related matters.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We're just here to ask around, it shouldn't be that serious, right?"

conversation.speaker: player13
conversation.text: "If possible, of course it's best to resolve things in a reasonable and legal way."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player12. The worker flings a sheet of still-wet ink paper, with crudely printed characters blurring in blue: Oppose Exploitation of Railway Workers! Below the title is a comparison table of bread prices, and at the bottom is a printed image of a crushed pocket watch, its broken hands pointing to the eight-hour mark.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Glances around to observe where the more decently dressed people are queuing.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Wanders among the crowd of workers, seeing if any are crying in misery or if the workers have injuries—usually some accident triggers a strike.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Your gaze finally settles on the independent counter under the left archway, where an old gentleman in a silver-gray waistcoat is lightly tapping the floor with an ivory-handled cane, followed by two attendants carrying document boxes.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Using sign language: "The marshal's construction materials? Didn't the war just end a few years ago? Is he building a bunker?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Tries to translate Professor Bailan's meaning into polite expression as best as possible.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Applying for a cultural relics investigation regarding the old residence of Count Fenanik. The applicant is a professor from Miskatonic University in the US. Need to know the approximate location." #Quietly writes on a piece of paper, leaves own signature, and slips over a small tip.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The bandaged worker glances around and quickly signs: The marshal is building an air-raid shelter for his villa!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Tries to persuade him that our related documents are on the way and will arrive soon, but the school's deadline is very, very tight.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st show

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Then takes out some additional tip as compensation for making an exception.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s current registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .rab Persuade

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; what you expect will surely receive a response, <player2>'s Persuade invocation:

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Salutes with one hand to indicate "Marshal", points at self to indicate "yes", with an indignant expression, pushes nose up to make a pig snout to indicate "a beast", makes pistol shapes with both hands and shoots at each other to indicate "war", pretends to run quickly in place, asks "Is war coming?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (Actions with visuals are indeed better for RP)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Huh? No. 6 Old Monastery Site, after renovation, is Dr. Lomien's residence. He came to pay property tax just last week.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Alright, thank you. Do you have contact information for this gentleman?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The clinic's phone is Garon District Exchange 2948—but on Tuesdays you'll have to dial three times! That surgery maniac cuts from 8 AM till dark, the operator always says the line's busy...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Jots it down in a little notebook

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Points at the workers to indicate "you"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .stshow Psychology

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player2>'s current registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .stshow Psychology

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s current registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Forms a triangle and releases it to indicate collapse, then flattens the gesture———

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: ✋→🚧 (Clearing the site)

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Laughs heartily, comforting them.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Checks what day of the week it is today.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Monday

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Before leaving, curiously asks which railway they are workers for, then enters the city hall to regroup with companions.
